note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `hasCriticalFinding` covers pneumothorax, free intraperitoneal air, and an *unstable* fracture specifically — a stable, minimally displaced fracture (`fracture` true, `unstableFracture` false) grades only moderate severity via the general actionable-finding rule and never trips the critical predicate. The second persona below isolates exactly that distinction.

personas.description: A normal pre-operative chest radiograph, asymptomatic: lungs clear bilaterally, no consolidation, effusion, pneumothorax, or free air, normal heart size, no fracture or bony lesion, every mandatory report section present — expect normal classification + none severity + 100% completeness + routine follow-up + no-action.

state.recommendedFollowUp: No further imaging follow-up required for this indication.

personas.name: abnormal-stable-distal-radius-fracture-moderate-not-critical-complete
personas.description: A right wrist X-ray after a fall onto an outstretched hand shows a minimally displaced, extra-articular distal radius fracture with no significant angulation and a congruent distal radio-ulnar joint: `hasCriticalFinding` requires an *unstable* fracture specifically, so this stable fracture grades only moderate severity via the general actionable-finding rule and never trips the critical predicate; report complete — expect abnormal classification + moderate severity (reportingCategory abnormal-acute) + 100% completeness + recommended follow-up + further-imaging.

state.projections: PA and lateral right wrist radiograph.
state.clinicalHistory: Fall onto an outstretched right hand; right wrist X-ray to assess for fracture.
state.comparisonWithPrevious: No previous right wrist radiograph on file.
state.findingsNarrative: A minimally displaced, extra-articular fracture of the distal radius is seen, with no significant angulation. Distal radio-ulnar joint congruent. No dislocation.
state.impression: Minimally displaced, stable extra-articular distal radius fracture.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Refer to the fracture clinic for cast immobilisation and follow-up per local pathway.

expected.recommendedAction: Recommend follow-up imaging or specialist referral as clinically indicated.

personas.name: critical-large-pneumothorax-uncommunicated-incomplete
personas.description: An erect chest radiograph shows a large right-sided pneumothorax with approximately 40% lung collapse and mediastinal structures central, with no evidence of tension physiology on this static view but close observation advised: pneumothorax is a critical structured finding that auto-escalates classification to critical and follow-up to critical-alert regardless of the other axes; the result has not yet been recorded as communicated, no originating request is linked, and the clinical history, comparison, and impression sections are not yet completed while urgent chest drain insertion is arranged — expect critical classification + major severity + 40% completeness + critical-alert follow-up + urgent-review.

state.findingsNarrative: A large right-sided pneumothorax is seen with approximately 40% lung collapse and mediastinal structures central; no evidence of tension physiology on this static view, but close observation is advised.
state.clinicianNotes: Phoned through to the on-call medical and respiratory teams immediately; urgent chest drain insertion being arranged.
